evidence.title: Most families of troops killed in Iran strike in Kuwait weren't at Trump event

occurrences.checkable_against: Military medical records and interviews with wounded soldiers
occurrences.quote_span: U.S. soldiers wounded in the attack told the AP of the unheeded concerns they raised about the threat and that the military medical system failed them in the weeks that followed.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. soldiers wounded in the attack
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Department of Defense casualty reports for the 2026 Iran war
occurrences.quote_span: wounded more than 800 others.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Army casualty records for the March 1 Port Shuaiba strike and White House reception attendance records
occurrences.quote_span: Most families of the six soldiers killed in the deadliest attack of the Iran war were not attending a major White House event for Gold Star families hosted by President Donald Trump.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: Joey Amor's public Facebook statement
occurrences.quote_span: “There are questions about what happened before the attack, what information was available, what decisions were made, and what happened in the moments leading up to six American soldiers losing their lives,” Joey Amor — whose 39-year-old wife, Master Sgt. Nicole M. Amor, was among those killed — said in a public Facebook statement Monday.
occurrences.speaker: Joey Amor
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: Tina Marzan's statement to the Associated Press
occurrences.quote_span: “We should be there,” Tina Marzan told the AP. “I mean, that’s not a question.”
occurrences.speaker: Tina Marzan
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: White House invitation records and Tina Marzan's statement
occurrences.quote_span: The widow of Chief Warrant Officer 3 Robert Marzan, who died in the March 1 attack, said she and her two children were not invited.
occurrences.speaker: Tina Marzan
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. military force-protection records and survivor interviews
occurrences.quote_span: Troops who survived the attack have raised questions about why they were stationed at a site that didn’t have sufficient air protection and was viewed as a likely target.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Iranian drone strike on Port Shuaiba in Kuwait

occurrences.checkable_against: Associated Press interview records

occurrences.checkable_against: Joey Amor's public Facebook statement
occurrences.quote_span: “I am done asking quietly. Today, I am asking the American people to stand with these six families and demand transparency.”
